csv_scope_of_work: Consulting firm to conduct a comprehensive Development Services Department Permit Fee Study for the City of Chula Vista. The study will include a full cost-of-service (COS) analysis, modernization of the Master Fee schedules, and an in-depth evaluation of deposit-based versus flat-fee structures. The intent is to ensure transparency, equity, administrative efficiency, and compliance with California regulatory requirements, while establishing a defensible fee structure that supports the City s long-term fiscal sustainability and service delivery goals.
